card.name: Words just before "opposite"
card.fires_on: Words right before "opposite", "opposed" or "reverse", such as "the" in "just the" or "exactly the", or the start of "opposite" itself. It marks a claim that something is the contrary of what was expected.

modes.label: Before "opposite"
modes.description: "the", "and" or "exact" after just, exactly or equal, leading into "opposite" or "reverse".
modes.example: Yet the real results have been just<< the>> opposite: wages have stagnated in Mexico

modes.label: Inside "opposite" or similar
modes.description: The start or middle of "opposite", "opposed" or "at odds" wording.
modes.example: palm oil does the <<op>>posite to providing money.

card.writes: It boosts "opposite", "opposed", "opposing" and "opposition" as the next word.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say that something is the opposite of what was expected.
